description: OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go gateway (/zen/v1…): OpenAI chat/completions, Anthropic Messages (root appends /v1/messages), and Gemini models base. Do not mix with OpenCode Go (/zen/go/v1…). Some GPT models on Zen use /v1/responses instead of chat/completions—route those separately if needed. See opencode.ai/docs/zen.

zh.name: OpenCode Zen
zh.description: OpenCode Zen 按量网关（/zen/v1），支持 OpenAI、Anthropic 与 Gemini；勿与 Go 套餐端点混用。

en.name: OpenCode Zen
en.description: OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go gateway (/zen/v1) with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini; do not mix with Go endpoints.

name: OpenCode Go
description: OpenCode Go subscription-only endpoints (/zen/go/v1…): OpenAI chat/completions + Anthropic Messages. Do not mix with OpenCode Zen (/zen/v1…) or plan quota will not apply. Model list is open-coding focused (no Gemini on this template). See opencode.ai/docs/go.

zh.name: OpenCode Go
zh.description: OpenCode Go 订阅套餐专用端点（/zen/go/v1），支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic；勿与 Zen 按量端点混用。

en.name: OpenCode Go
en.description: OpenCode Go subscription endpoints (/zen/go/v1) for OpenAI and Anthropic; do not mix with Zen pay-as-you-go.

name: Command Code
description: Command Code Provider API: OpenAI chat/completions for GPT/open-source/Gemini-shaped models; Anthropic Messages for Claude (root appends /v1/messages). Sending a Claude model to /chat/completions (or the reverse) returns 400. Optional ZDR header x-cmd-zdr is not configured by this template. See commandcode.ai/docs/provider.

zh.name: Command Code
zh.description: Command Code Provider API，按模型分别使用 OpenAI Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages。

en.name: Command Code
en.description: Command Code Provider API with OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages, split by model family.

name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
description: OpenAI-compatible chat-only router (router.huggingface.co/v1). Model IDs often use org/model:provider (or :fastest). Requires an HF token with Inference Providers permission. Not a full OpenAI Images/Audio root.

zh.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
zh.description: Hugging Face 推理路由的 OpenAI 兼容对话 API，可按模型指定上游供应商。

en.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
en.description: Hugging Face’s OpenAI-compatible chat router across many inference providers.

name: Vercel AI Gateway
description: Vercel AI Gateway explicit OpenAI chat + responses under /v1, and Anthropic Messages (root appends /v1/messages). No openai.base, so images and audio are not implied. Auth is the AI Gateway API key (or Vercel OIDC). Model IDs use provider/model slugs. See vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway.

zh.name: Vercel AI Gateway
zh.description: Vercel AI Gateway 聚合网关，支持 OpenAI 兼容协议与 Anthropic Messages。

en.name: Vercel AI Gateway
en.description: Vercel AI Gateway with OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages endpoints.

name: ZenMux
description: ZenMux aggregation API: OpenAI-compatible root (/api/v1) + Anthropic Messages base (/api/anthropic) + Gemini Vertex-compatible prefix (/api/vertex-ai/v1/publishers/google/models, Bearer). Pay As You Go and Builder Plan share the same endpoints—billing differs by API key only. Use provider_model_name without the google/ slug prefix. See docs.zenmux.ai.

zh.name: ZenMux
zh.description: ZenMux 聚合平台（OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini；Pay As You Go 与 Builder 订阅共用端点，按 API Key 区分计费）。

en.name: ZenMux
en.description: ZenMux aggregation API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini); Pay As You Go and Builder Plan share endpoints and differ by API key only.

name: SCNet
description: SCNet (National Supercomputing Internet) OpenAI chat + Anthropic Messages. Pay-as-you-go (sk-), Token Plan (sk-tp-), and Coding Plan (sk-sp-) share these endpoints—do not mix keys. Token Plan keys are intended for interactive AI tools, not backend batch APIs. See scnet.cn OpenAPI docs.

zh.name: 超算互联网 SCNet
zh.description: 国家超算互联网模型 API，支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 兼容协议。

en.name: SCNet
en.description: National Supercomputing Internet model API with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

name: SiliconFlow
description: China SiliconFlow explicit OpenAI chat, images/generations, audio/transcriptions, and audio/speech. No openai.base, so responses and edits are not implied. Anthropic Messages is POST /v1/messages, so the Anthropic base is the host root, not /v1. Do not mix with international api.siliconflow.com keys or cloud.siliconflow.com accounts.

zh.name: 硅基流动
zh.description: 硅基流动国内站，支持 OpenAI 兼容接口与 Anthropic Messages。

en.name: SiliconFlow
en.description: SiliconFlow China Model Cloud with OpenAI-compatible APIs and Anthropic Messages.

name: SiliconFlow (International)
description: International SiliconFlow explicit OpenAI chat, images/generations, audio/transcriptions, and audio/speech on api.siliconflow.com. No openai.base, so responses and edits are not implied. Not for mainland China accounts; do not mix with api.siliconflow.cn keys.

zh.name: 硅基流动（国际站）
zh.description: 硅基流动国际站的 OpenAI 兼容 API。

en.name: SiliconFlow (International)
en.description: SiliconFlow’s international Model Cloud OpenAI-compatible API.

name: Ollama (Local)
description: Default local Ollama OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (LLM only). For remote or container deployments, change the host/port in the chat URL.

zh.name: Ollama（本地）
zh.description: 本地 Ollama 默认 OpenAI 兼容端点；无需平台 API Key。

en.name: Ollama (Local)
en.description: Default local Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint; no platform API key is required.
